planets.name: TOI-283 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-283 with a 17.6-day year, found in 2025.

text.card: TOI-283 b was found in 2025 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-283. Its orbit and size follow Murgas et al. 2025's fit, the archive's default.
